verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA H200 SXM is a data-center GPU. It has no user interface of its own whose functions an API could match, so API/UI parity is the wrong axis for this kind of product. CUDA, Brev and the build.nvidia.com endpoints are separate software products, so their APIs or UIs say nothing about UI parity for the GPU itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
